title: Al-Insan 76:6-10 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y9 lesson 40 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Al-Insan 76:6-10 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 40. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: عَيْنًۭا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيرًۭا (٦) يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْمًۭا كَانَ شَرُّهُۥ مُسْتَطِيرًۭا (٧) وَيُطْعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ مِسْكِينًۭا وَيَتِيمًۭا وَأَسِيرًا (٨) إِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ ٱللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمْ جَزَآءًۭ وَلَا شُكُورًا (٩) إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوْمًا عَبُوسًۭا قَمْطَرِيرًۭا (١٠)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: A spring of which the [righteous] servants of Allah will drink; they will make it gush forth in force [and abundance].
They [are those who] fulfill [their] vows and fear a Day whose evil will be widespread.
And they give food in spite of love for it to the needy, the orphan, and the captive,
[Saying], "We feed you only for the countenance of Allah. We wish not from you reward or gratitude.
Indeed, We fear from our Lord a Day austere and distressful."

keywords.def: the countenance of Allah: for His sake alone

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-Insan 76:6-10 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 76:6-10 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 76:6-10 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: List the three groups fed in 76:8.
questions.a: The poor (miskin), the orphan (yatim) and the captive (asir).

questions.q: 76:8 says 'despite love for it'. What does that add to the deed?
questions.a: They give food they themselves want: real sacrifice.

questions.q: Why do the righteous feed others (76:9)?
options: For the countenance of Allah alone
questions.a: A) For the countenance of Allah alone. 76:9.

questions.q: Al-Insan 76:8: «وَيُطْعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ ...» Which word comes next?
Think again: The righteous feed the poor, the orphan and the captive 'for the countenance of Allah', wanting no thanks (76:8 to 9). Why is giving without wanting thanks so powerful?
questions.a: It is sincere (ikhlas): the reward is with Allah, and it protects the giver from showing off.
